d:
Shadow figures darting down pitch-black corridors, objects moving on their own, and voices answering questions in empty rooms. Step inside the darkest lockdowns of Ghost Adventures to see what the crew actually caught inside these haunted walls. Armed with night-vision cameras and digital recorders, every investigation pushes past skepticism into raw, unexplained terror.
Watch Ghost Adventures Season 4 Episodes 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10 & 13 on Discovery Channel India.
